definitions.explanation: Calling back, replying, or making a return trip. Often used as an adverb meaning 'in return' or 'right back'.
A fold or crease in fabric or paper, or a turnaround point on a route.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{電話|でんわ}します→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
{折|お}り{返|かえ}しお⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: Could I get a reply from you?

examples.japanese: ⟦{留守番電話|るすばんでんわ}→留守番電話：15878_rusubandenwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れたら→入れる：01098_ireru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: After I left a message on the answering machine, I got a call back right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧。
examples.english: The turnaround point of the marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す。
examples.english: To fix the cuff on the pants.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、あと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下|くだ}り{坂|ざか}→下り坂：16377_kudarizaka⟧だ。
examples.english: Once you pass the turnaround point, it's all downhill from there.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is extremely common in business and daily communication. {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧ (to call back) and {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧ (to get back in touch) are standard phrases. Can function as an adverb (without a particle): {折|お}り{返|かえ}しご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please get back to me).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧: to call back
- {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to get back in touch
- {折|お}り{返|かえ}し⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧: turnaround point
